connector.name: Memo AI - meeting assistant
connector.registryDescription: Search transcripts and summaries of your meetings, calls, and recordings in Memo AI
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package memoai-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace tech.memoai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MEMO_API_URL
env.description: Memo AI API base URL (defaults to https://app.memoai.tech)
